data.name: HANA_ExisteConfAPI
data.value: SELECT * FROM "@EXX_SIRE_APIS" WHERE "Code" = '{0}'

data.name: HANA_ListarEmpresas
data.value: SELECT "Code", "U_EXX_RUC" || ' ' || (CASE WHEN "Code" = '0' THEN (SELECT "CompnyName" FROM OADM) ELSE (SELECT "BPLName" FROM OBPL A WHERE A."BPLId" = T0."Code") END)AS "Empresa" FROM "@EXX_SIRE_APIS" T0 ORDER BY TO_INTEGER(T0."Code")

data.name: HANA_ListarSetup
data.value: SELECT "Code", "Name", IFNULL("U_EXX_ADDN", '') AS "U_EXX_ADDN", IFNULL("U_EXX_VERS", '') AS "U_EXX_VERS", IFNULL("U_EXX_RUTA", '') AS "U_EXX_RUTA" FROM "@EXX_SETUP";

data.name: HANA_MultiBranch
data.value: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "OBPL"

data.name: HANA_ObtenerConfiguracion
data.value: SELECT "Code", IFNULL("U_EXX_CONS", '') AS "U_EXX_CONS", IFNULL("U_EXX_URSL", '') AS "U_EXX_URSL", IFNULL("U_EXX_VSAP", '') AS "U_EXX_VSAP", IFNULL("U_EXX_VSIR", '') AS "U_EXX_VSIR" FROM "@EXX_SIRE_CONF" WHERE "Code" = '01';

data.name: HANA_ObtieneConfAPIxOADM
data.value: SELECT '0' AS "BPLId", T0."TaxIdNum" AS "GlblLocNum", T0."CompnyName" AS "BPLName", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_APIS", '') AS "U_EXX_APIS", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_USER", '') AS "U_EXX_USER", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_PASS", '') AS "U_EXX_PASS", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_CLID", '') AS "U_EXX_CLID", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_CLSE", '') AS "U_EXX_CLSE" FROM OADM T0 LEFT JOIN "@EXX_SIRE_APIS" T1 ON T1."Code" = '0' ORDER BY 1

data.name: HANA_ObtieneConfAPIxSucursal
data.value: SELECT T0."BPLId", T0."GlblLocNum", T0."BPLName", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_APIS", '') AS "U_EXX_APIS", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_USER", '') AS "U_EXX_USER", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_PASS", '') AS "U_EXX_PASS", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_CLID", '') AS "U_EXX_CLID", IFNULL(T1."U_EXX_CLSE", '') AS "U_EXX_CLSE" FROM OBPL T0 LEFT JOIN "@EXX_SIRE_APIS" T1 ON T0."BPLId" = T1."Code" ORDER BY 1

data.name: HANA_ObtieneLlavesDocumentos
data.value: SELECT T0."ObjType", T0."DocEntry" FROM OPCH T0 INNER JOIN OCRD T1 ON T0."CardCode" = T1."CardCode" WHERE IFNULL(T0."BPLId", 0) = {0} AND T1."LicTradNum" = '{1}' AND T0."Indicator" = '{2}' AND T0."NumAtCard" = '{3}-{4}' UNION ALL SELECT T0."ObjType", T0."DocEntry" FROM ODPO T0 INNER JOIN OCRD T1 ON T0."CardCode" = T1."CardCode" WHERE IFNULL(T0."BPLId", 0) = {0} AND T1."LicTradNum" = '{1}' AND T0."Indicator" = '{2}' AND T0."NumAtCard" = '{3}-{4}' UNION ALL SELECT T0."ObjType", T0."DocEntry" FROM ORPC T0 INNER JOIN OCRD T1 ON T0."CardCode" = T1."CardCode" WHERE IFNULL(T0."BPLId", 0) = {0} AND T1."LicTradNum" = '{1}' AND T0."Indicator" = '{2}' AND T0."NumAtCard" = '{3}-{4}'

data.name: HANA_ValidaExisteRegistroCompra
data.value: SELECT * FROM "@EXX_SIRE_COMP" WHERE "U_EXX_PERIODO" = '{0}' AND "U_EXX_BPLID" = '{1}'

data.name: HANA_ValidarTabla
data.value: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM SYS.M_TABLES WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = '{0}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{1}';
